finding.claim: byScanner accounting only counts "spark"/"wonder"/"both" and drops findings proposed as "secondary" when models are equal, so secondary-only findings are invisible in counts and logs.
finding.title: byScanner counts ignore secondary label

verifier.reason: Confirmed: cli.mjs:376 assigns proposedBy "secondary" when the scanner models are equal, while cli.mjs:433-438 byScanner only counts "spark", "wonder", "both", and "controlled", and cli.mjs:440-444 logs only that breakdown, so secondary-only entries contribute to no byScanner count.

repro.reason: byScanner is a non-exported local constant computed inline inside main() in cli.mjs (lines 433-438); cli.mjs exports only evidenceLevelFor and buildRunBanner, neither of which accepts proposedEntries or computes scanner counts. mergeScannerRuns in scan/merge.mjs only preserves proposedBy labels and does not compute byScanner, so calling it cannot expose the drop. Faithfully exercising the defect requires a full dual-scan analyze run through unexported main(), including loadConfig environment, a target repository, scanner agents/model or mock pipeline, equal scanner/secondary model configuration, and filesystem report output, which cannot be invoked through an imported exported symbol under the stated constraints.

finding.claim: wordRegex uses a plain {} as cache and tests __idRegexCache[name] directly, so inherited properties like toString, constructor, hasOwnProperty or __proto__ return a non-RegExp value and subsequent .test crashes instead of creating a fresh RegExp.
finding.title: Prototype-polluted regex cache returns inherited value

verifier.reason: The cache is a plain object at repro/static-checks.mjs:7 with only a truthiness guard at repro/static-checks.mjs:9, so inherited truthy properties such as toString or __proto__ bypass RegExp creation and are returned at repro/static-checks.mjs:12, after which callers invoke .test at repro/static-checks.mjs:137 and repro/static-checks.mjs:140.

finding.claim: hasTautology tests self-comparison against the whole file instead of assert segments, so any x===x outside an assertion is reported as a tautological assertion and causes valid reproducers to be rejected.
finding.title: Self-comparison checked on whole file not assertions

verifier.reason: At repro/static-checks.mjs:112-114 hasTautology tests the selfCompare regex against the whole unscoped code argument and returns "self-comparison" before extractAssertSegments is only invoked at repro/static-checks.mjs:115 for the later checks, so any x===x outside an assert segment triggers the tautology rejection.

finding.claim: firstJsonObject treats backslash as an escape even when not inside a string, so the character after an outside-string backslash is skipped and cannot toggle inString or update brace depth, corrupting object boundary detection.
finding.title: Escape flag set outside string literals corrupts JSON scanning

verifier.reason: The code at run/json.mjs:56-57 unconditionally consumes the next character and sets escape on any backslash before the quote toggle at run/json.mjs:58 and brace-depth handling at run/json.mjs:60-62, so an outside-string backslash does skip a quote or brace and corrupt boundary detection.

finding.claim: proof suffix claims the imported symbol executed for any LinkCheck status except 'unproven', so statuses like failed/error/timeout are still reported as executed proof.

verifier.reason: The ternary at synthesize/index.mjs:192 appends the proof suffix for every status other than 'unproven', and 'error' is a real non-proven status produced at repro/linkcheck.mjs:93 and repro/linkcheck.mjs:101, so an error LinkCheck would be printed as 'the imported symbol executed under inspector coverage.'
